statement.zh: 萨哈贡《佛罗伦萨抄本》传统是墨西卡宗教与社会研究的早期殖民民族史基础文献（scholarly editions）。
statement.en: Sahagún's Florentine Codex tradition is a foundational early colonial ethnohistoric source for Mexica religion and society (scholarly editions).
